name: First-five-laps overtakes by R P S T category
description: Count position-crossing overtakes only in laps 1..5. An overtake is a pair of drivers where passer ends ahead of passed on lap L but was behind on lap L-1. Classify in order: R if the overtaken driver appears in retirements on the same lap; P if the overtaken driver pitted on lap L (pit entry) or lap L-1 (pit exit); S if lap=1 and the two drivers' previous positions differ by at most 2 (start shuffle); otherwise T (track). Return categories Retirement/Pit/Start/Track or R/P/S/T with counts. Not for season points or standings.
sql: WITH race_laps AS (SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap, position FROM lap_positions WHERE lap BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND lap_type = 'Race'), pairs AS (SELECT a.race_id, a.lap, a.driver_id AS passer, b.driver_id AS passed, pa.position AS a_prev, pb.position AS b_prev FROM race_laps a JOIN race_laps b ON a.race_id = b.race_id AND a.lap = b.lap AND a.driver_id <> b.driver_id JOIN lap_positions pa ON pa.race_id = a.race_id AND pa.driver_id = a.driver_id AND pa.lap = a.lap - 1 JOIN lap_positions pb ON pb.race_id = b.race_id AND pb.driver_id = b.driver_id AND pb.lap = b.lap - 1 WHERE a.position < b.position AND pa.position > pb.position), classified AS (SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM retirements r WHERE r.race_id = pairs.race_id AND r.driver_id = pairs.passed AND r.lap = pairs.lap) THEN 'R' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pit_stops p WHERE p.race_id = pairs.race_id AND p.driver_id = pairs.passed AND (p.lap = pairs.lap OR p.lap = pairs.lap - 1)) THEN 'P' WHEN pairs.lap = 1 AND ABS(a_prev - b_prev) <= 2 THEN 'S' ELSE 'T' END AS category FROM pairs) SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS overtake_count FROM classified GROUP BY category

name: Fewest season points via final-round driver_standings
description: For constructors with the most seasons having a fewest-points scoring driver (year>=2001): season points = driver_standings.points on the final round of that year (MAX(round) in races), keep only points>0, take MIN points drivers per year, map driver→constructor via team_driver_ranks for that year (not results.constructor_id), count distinct years per constructor, top 5. Do NOT SUM(results.points) for this fewest-points question. Overtake / lap_positions questions do not use this.
sql: WITH final_rounds AS (SELECT year, MAX(round) AS final_round FROM races WHERE year >= 2001 GROUP BY year), season_driver_points AS (SELECT r.year, ds.driver_id, ds.points FROM driver_standings AS ds INNER JOIN races AS r ON ds.race_id = r.race_id INNER JOIN final_rounds AS fr ON r.year = fr.year AND r.round = fr.final_round WHERE ds.points > 0), season_min_points AS (SELECT year, MIN(points) AS fewest_points FROM season_driver_points GROUP BY year), lowest_point_drivers AS (SELECT sdp.year, sdp.driver_id FROM season_driver_points AS sdp INNER JOIN season_min_points AS smp ON sdp.year = smp.year AND sdp.points = smp.fewest_points), constructor_lowest_seasons AS (SELECT DISTINCT lpd.year, tdr.constructor_id FROM lowest_point_drivers AS lpd INNER JOIN team_driver_ranks AS tdr ON lpd.year = tdr.year AND lpd.driver_id = tdr.driver_id) SELECT c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT cls.year) AS seasons_with_fewest_point_scoring_driver FROM constructor_lowest_seasons AS cls INNER JOIN constructors AS c ON cls.constructor_id = c.constructor_id GROUP BY c.constructor_id, c.name ORDER BY seasons_with_fewest_point_scoring_driver DESC, c.name LIMIT 5
